title: Sales funnel qualification
bodyMd:
Leads are unique within each channel and no lead belongs to more than one channel. Qualification follows one common rule.

| Category | Leads | Qualified leads |
|---|---:|---:|
| Referral | 80 | 60 |
| Web | 160 | 64 |
| Event | 160 | 88 |
